categories.name: Tributes
categories.intro: The music of the artists your guests already love, played live by acts who study every note, costume and stage move. From ABBA to AC/DC, Dolly to the Stones.

categories.name: Top 40 & variety
categories.intro: Bands that read a room and keep the dance floor full, with sets that run from the classics to this year's hits.

categories.name: Recording acts
categories.intro: Artists with their own songs and records, for audiences and stages that want something original.

categories.name: DJs
categories.type: Club, party, wedding and corporate DJs
categories.intro: DJs for weddings, corporate nights and parties, who can also run the microphone and keep the schedule moving.

categories.name: Novelty
categories.intro: Magic, hypnosis, comedy and unusual acts that get strangers talking and give an event its stories.

categories.name: Jazz & easy listening
categories.type: Smooth jazz, lounge singers and instrumentalists
categories.intro: Singers and players for dinners, receptions and lounges, where the music should set a mood without drowning out conversation.

categories.name: Asian talent
categories.intro: Traditional and contemporary performers, from cultural dance to modern stage shows, for festivals and celebrations.

categories.name: Makeup artists
categories.intro: Makeup artists for wedding parties, photo shoots and stage, from natural beauty looks to full theatrical work.

categories.name: Models
categories.intro: Models for fashion shows, promotions, trade shows and commercial shoots.

acts.name: ABBA Revisited
acts.bio: A Canadian-produced concert that recreates ABBA on stage, with four lead performers who look and sound the part and a nine-piece cast behind them. The show runs through more than twenty hits with costume changes, choreography and a live band, and has toured internationally, including Malaysia.
credits: The CNE in Toronto called it their number one show in 2000
Toured Canada, the U.S. and internationally

acts.name: Draw the Line
acts.bio: A Boston band that has spent about fifteen years playing Aerosmith's catalogue across the U.S. and abroad, from Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands to England, South America and Japan.
credits: The only Aerosmith tribute endorsed by Aerosmith, according to the band
Over 2,000 shows in more than 100 cities
Played all but two U.S. states

acts.name: Voodoo Lounge
acts.bio: Named after the Stones' 1994 album, Voodoo Lounge is fronted by Chris Newman as Mick Jagger, with the voice, the strut and the hits from the sixties onward.
credits: Frontman Chris Newman as Mick Jagger

acts.name: Simply Queen
acts.bio: From Windsor, Ontario, Simply Queen is led by Rick Rock as Freddie Mercury, who sings and plays guitar and piano, with Wayne Brauer, Mitch Taylor and Phil Charrette recreating Queen's big live sound.
credits: Festivals, theatres and arenas across North America

acts.name: The Beatle Band
acts.bio: Formerly The FabFour Canada, the band focuses on the touring years of 1963 to 1966, and also recreates the 1969 rooftop concert.
credits: Formerly known as The FabFour Canada

acts.name: Sandman
acts.bio: Playing Metallica since 1994, Sandman covers the whole catalogue, from Kill 'Em All to the orchestral S&M era.
credits: The only tribute band sanctioned by Metallica, given in 2016 according to the band
Met Metallica in person at Toronto's Opera House, November 2016

acts.name: Thunderstruck
acts.bio: On stage since January 2001, Thunderstruck plays AC/DC on Gibson SGs and Marshall stacks, covering both the Bon Scott and Brian Johnson eras.
songs: You Shook Me All Night Long

acts.name: Laurie Lynn
acts.bio: A Newfoundland-born country singer who started performing at nine. After raising her children she returned to the stage as Dolly Parton, her childhood idol, with the vibrato, the one-liners and the humour.
credits: Started performing at the Corner Brook Arts and Culture Centre

acts.name: Neon Nostalgic
acts.bio: A live band synced to the original music videos on screen behind them: part concert, part dance party, all 80s and 90s.
songs: I Want You to Want Me

acts.name: Wednesday's Engine
acts.bio: A five-piece pop, rock and dance band from Ontario, known for unexpected takes on familiar songs.

acts.name: The Silver Elvis
acts.type: Peter Jarvis, living statue and street performer
acts.bio: Toronto performer Peter Jarvis brings four decades of mime, dance, clowning and mask work, on stages and at street festivals around the world.
credits: Writer and performer on Sesame Street, Cirque du Soleil and Vid Kids
Performed in the USA, England, Australia, New Zealand, Malaysia, Poland and Turkey

acts.name: The Incredible Boris
acts.bio: A clean comedy hypnosis show, tailored to each event, that turns volunteers from the audience into the stars of the night.
credits: Seen on Maury, the Howie Mandel Show and Just for Laughs
